summary: Byte-executed the persisted v3 CLOSE/replay graph, found that persisted blob provenance was not executable because sibling loaders did not verify file bytes, built a transitive verified-graph replay wrapper, then carried schema-v2 replay_authorized_v1 through a new launch gate and a trust-rooted process-stable runtime. The first runtime sketch was superseded because it accepted the trusted certificate registry/current runtime as per-call inputs. V5 fixes the authority boundary: the trust registry and live runtime/invalidation providers are fixed at RuntimeContext bootstrap. FAIL_CLOSED remains available without replay authority and no default runtime was switched.

new_measurement_validity_finding.name: provenance-string-without-byte-verification
new_measurement_validity_finding.counterexample: In a copied deployment graph, changed reservation_compliance_auditor_runtime_provenance_v2 fail-closed scientific score from 1.0 to 0.0. The modified auditor Git blob was ff946777d7c7d71c624d58e1b4dd640cd0d75960, while the generated durable CLOSE still claimed the frozen expected blob b74465bd5f68882cee4c5b3fbd2a98d73a684b81. The same modified environment generated and replayed a closed score 0.0 successfully. Moving that journal to the exact graph rejected it with rederived compliance audit mismatch.
new_measurement_validity_finding.interpretation: Persisted filenames/blob strings do not prove which code actually executed. Code identity must be verified before scientific evidence generation/replay, and the verified set must cover the transitive semantic dependency graph.
new_measurement_validity_finding.not_claimed: This is an existence counterexample against the loader contract, not evidence that the production filesystem is currently modified.

runtime_v4_superseded.superseded_reason: per-call trusted_registry/current_runtime would let an unprivileged caller manufacture the replay trust root if exposed as the authorization boundary

crash_validation.note: All nonempty byte cuts were exhaustively checked with the exact framed-prefix parser. Representative first/header/mid/last ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE cuts were also passed through verified scientific replay. Full verified replay at every cut across all three large frames exceeded the per-command runtime budget; v3 schema-v2 CLOSE itself had already been exhaustively verified across all 2773 cuts earlier in this run.

false_certificate_stress.analytic_point: If a genuinely stochastic Bernoulli(0.5) protected statistic is falsely certified deterministic, a caller that keeps first-attempt success and replays once after first-attempt failure raises accepted success probability to 0.75.
false_certificate_stress.rule: Registry membership is authorization, not empirical proof of determinism. The certificate-issuance/trust-bootstrap process is part of the scientific validity boundary.

revisions: The first runtime candidate was not promoted: its per-call trust inputs were recognized as an authority-confusion flaw and superseded by trust-rooted v5.

Cross-process authorization dataclasses are no longer assumed to compare across module reloads; v5 reconstructs persisted authorization data into the current process module types and revalidates every field.
Code-identity verification was expanded from CLOSE/replay transitive dependencies to the launch gate/attempt/score/pipeline/auth/registry/close entrypoint graph before score operations.
scope_limitations: No default/active runtime was switched. DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY remains a research candidate; FAIL_CLOSED remains the safe active path.
The privileged bootstrap that supplies v5 trusted registry and runtime/invalidation providers is still external to v5 and must itself be content-addressed/verified before production use.
The deterministic scorer used for positive replay validation was a hash(attempt_id) toy at the declared score statistic; no LLM runtime determinism certificate was established.
Pre/post filename Git-blob checks close ordinary deployment drift but are not an adversarial secure loader against a writer racing mutation during a call and restoring bytes before the post-check.
Single-host fsync/flock writer semantics and distributed fencing were not re-proven in this checkpoint; earlier role-local durable-writer limitations still apply.
frontier: Move the trusted certificate registry generation/digest and runtime snapshot/invalidation provider implementations behind a verified bootstrap artifact; per-call code must not be able to replace them.
Replace filename pre/post hashing with immutable content-addressed module loading or a verified package/container image digest so code bytes cannot change between verification and import/execution.

Define the certificate-issuance evidence contract for the protected statistic, including repeated fresh-process tests, fingerprint scope, revocation/invalidation conditions, and lifetime false-certification budget.

Stress v5 with multi-process durable writers plus actual fsync/crash points, reusing the stable-sidecar lock writer, to combine score authorization with the previously validated single-host race protocol.
Quantify the cost/benefit of DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY versus FAIL_CLOSED once a real deterministic scorer/runtime trace is available; do not enable replay based only on the toy scorer validation.
exact_continuation: Next run: first build a verified bootstrap object whose immutable digest binds the trusted certificate registry, runtime-snapshot provider implementation, invalidation provider implementation, and v5 runtime blob. Then rerun fresh-process replay using only that bootstrap object. Reject caller-supplied trust roots. In parallel, define a certificate-issuance test at the protected statistic and demonstrate that a deliberately stochastic scorer fails admission before any deterministic replay reservation can be issued.

termination.reason: Substantive exact byte execution, loader counterexample, hardening, trust-boundary revision, and crash validation were completed and persisted. The remaining frontier requires a new bootstrap/certificate-issuance layer rather than extending the now-validated v5 lifecycle in the same artifact.
